sloka: यदैव वानरैर्घोरैर्बद्धः सेतुर्महार्णवे ।तदैव हृदयेनाहं शङ्के रामममानुषम् ।। ६.११४.११ ।।
transliteration: yadaiva vānarairghorairbaddhaḥ seturmahārṇave ।tadaiva hṛdayenāhaṁ śaṅke rāmamamānuṣam ।। 6.114.11 ।।

translations.english: "When these terrific Vanaras constructed a bridge over the great ocean, I doubted in my mind at that time itself that Rama is not a mortal."
